title: Headless TTW Project Impurity (MQA): from President Eden's FEV vial in the player's hands (stage 10) to the vial handed to Elder Lyons at the Citadel (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Project Impurity starts when the player takes President Eden's FEV vial in Raven Rock (the FEV panel's activation sets MQA 10 [observed]; the MQ09 chain plays it). Given here: MQA 10, the vial held, and The American Dream at 60 (back to the Citadel). The ending played is the one that hands the vial to Elder Lyons (stage 200); the other, putting it into the purifier's FEV panel (MQAPanelScript), ends MQA 100 at Broken Steel's wake-up.
Travel stand-in: to Elder Lyons at the Citadel.
